stem: Which statement best explains the changes shown in this table?

options.label: F
options.text: Slaves from the Upper South were moved to the Lower South to work on cotton plantations.

options.label: G
options.text: The Upper South experienced an agricultural labor shortage in the antebellum period.

options.label: H
options.text: Slaves were transferred from the Lower South to the Upper South to work in newly built factories.

options.label: J
options.text: The Lower South lost population as settlers migrated west to establish new plantations.

visual_elements: Table titled 'Enslaved Populations of Selected States' with columns State, 1830, 1840, 1850 and rows Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, Tennessee, Alabama, Mississippi with enslaved population numbers for each year.
